text:
Alright, I've gone through your requests for this week. It sounds like you're making some intentional shifts to align your schedule with your "Grow as an engineer" why, which is great to see.

Here's how I've laid out the changes:

1.  Your "Reading & Labs (Core Engineering)" blocks on Tuesday and Thursday will be split. The first hour (7:00 AM to 8:00 AM) will now host two 30-minute labs: one for "Soft Skills Lab" and another for "Technical Lab: System Design, DB, AI Agents". The second hour (8:00 AM to 9:00 AM) of the original block will now be called "Core Engineering Study".
2.  Your "Book" blocks on Tuesday through Friday will be renamed "Study" and extended by an hour, running from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. To make room for this, your "Work" blocks on those days will now start at 12:00 PM and end at 5:00 PM, maintaining their 5-hour duration.
3.  Your "Community Time" blocks, both on weekdays at 4:00 PM and on the weekends, will be renamed "Dev Weekends" and their category changed to Learning.
4.  You mentioned "'Talking About Weekdays' stays there" for your 5:00 PM slot. Just to clarify, the block currently scheduled there on weekdays is "LeafCompute". I've kept it as is since you wanted it to stay.
